title: coprosma repens var. pumila
intro: Coprosma repens var. pumila, commonly known as the New Zealand Groundsel, is a shrub-like plant native to New Zealand. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues, such as colds, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Coprosma repens var. pumila include its ability to soothe and calm the body, reducing pain and inflammation, while also acting as an expectorant to help relieve congestion. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
